description: This Java source file defines a test utility class `CapturingMdcAdapterObserver` that extends an abstract observer for capturing MDC (Mapped Diagnostic Context) changes (puts and removes) for testing purposes within an Akka-based logging utility.

classes.name: CapturingMdcAdapterObserver
classes.description: A thread-safe class that captures MDC put entries and removed keys for testing, extending ObservableMdcAdapter.AbstractMdcAdapterObserver.

methods.name: CapturingMdcAdapterObserver()
methods.description: Constructor initializing synchronized lists to store put entries and removed keys.

methods.name: onPut
methods.description: Records a key-value pair when an MDC entry is put.

methods.name: onRemove
methods.description: Records a key when an MDC entry is removed.

methods.name: getAllPutEntries
methods.description: Returns an unmodifiable copy of all captured put entries.

methods.name: getAllRemovedKeys
methods.description: Returns an unmodifiable copy of all removed keys.
